caption: The drawing depicts a multi-story building featuring tall, arched windows lined in two rows, with each window spaced evenly along the facade. The upper row of windows opens onto a balcony with a detailed, repetitive balustrade that runs the length of the building. The structure has a steep, gabled roof with dormer windows set into it; shadows are cast on the roof to indicate sunlight coming from the upper right. There are various architectural details above and around the windows and along the roofline, such as ornate trim and decorative moldings. In the foreground, the edge of another roof appears, partially obscuring the lower portion of the main building. The image is rendered in shades of black and white, with a stippling technique used to create gradients and shadows, resulting in a detailed and textured composition.
title: Wrought Iron Balcony Rail
